name: @amodalai/example-access-request
description: An Amodal example that reviews IT access requests against a segregation-of-duties matrix, the requester's existing entitlements, and an access policy: an employee requests a role from a custom React UI, a durable tool runs the deterministic checks in code and delegates the judgment to a reviewer subagent, a system owner grants, returns, or denies, four stores keep the requests, entitlements, reviews, and events, and a preToolUse guard hook enforces the hard rules platform-wide.

amodal.name: access-request-example
amodal.description: Review IT access requests against a segregation-of-duties matrix, existing entitlements, and a fictional access policy. An employee requests a role, the access-reviewer subagent checks it and recommends grant, limit, escalate, or deny, and a system owner decides or returns it for a fix. The agent assists; a human decides.
